name: Marrupe (Spain)
description: Red field with a blue horizontal stripe edged white across the centre, charged with the crowned arms of Marrupe (a column between crescents on red).
history: Municipal flag of Marrupe; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
